notes.title: Security posture — one public, unauthenticated runtime endpoint that spends LLM and Tavily credit; secrets server-only; untrusted tool output rendered defensively
notes.summary: Trust boundary is app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]] (GET/POST, no auth, no rate limit, no middleware); env keys are read only server-side; client-supplied agent context and web-search results are untrusted and rendered without raw HTML, with an http/https link allow-list

improvements.title: Public /api/copilotkit accepts anonymous POSTs that spend LLM and Tavily credit
improvements.summary: The only server route runs the agent and Tavily search with server keys for any caller - no auth, rate limit or origin check; only maxSteps bounds one turn
improvements.fix: Before any deployment beyond a local demo, wrap the handler with an auth or signed-session check plus a per-IP rate limit (or put the deployment behind platform protection); keep maxSteps as the per-turn bound

improvements.title: Dark-mode tokens and dark: classes ship but nothing ever enables dark mode
improvements.summary: globals.css defines a .dark token block and a dark custom variant, and components carry dark: classes, but no code adds the dark class and no theme library is installed
improvements.fix: Decide: wire a toggle (or prefers-color-scheme) that sets the dark class, or delete the .dark block and dark: classes

improvements.title: lib/user-info.ts is imported by nothing
improvements.summary: getUser and getUsers are leftover demo mock code with no importer; they suggest a user model the app does not have

improvements.title: Conversion Rate KPI is a hard-coded constant presented as derived data
improvements.summary: calculateConversionRate divides customers by customers*8.13, so it always shows about 12.3% - and that fabricated figure is shown as a KPI tile and fed to the agent as a metric
improvements.fix: Either add a visitors series to the dataset and compute it, or relabel the tile and agent-context field as an assumed rate (or drop it)

improvements.title: pnpm lint calls oxlint, which is not a dependency
improvements.summary: The lint script runs oxlint . but oxlint is absent from package.json and the lockfile, so pnpm lint fails on a clean clone
improvements.fix: Add oxlint as an exact-pinned devDependency (pnpm add -D oxlint), or change the script to a linter that is installed

improvements.title: next 16.1.7 carries 2 critical and 12 high advisories - bump to 16.3.3
improvements.summary: rafa audit (osv-api + pnpm audit) flags 25 advisories on the direct dep next@16.1.7, incl. 2 critical unauthenticated RCEs; all fixed by 16.3.3
improvements.fix: Bump next to 16.3.3 (exact pin, same major so the README badge test still holds); run pnpm install, pnpm test, pnpm build

improvements.title: No CI - tests, type-check and build never run on push or PR
improvements.summary: The repo has no .github workflows or other CI config; pnpm test, check-types and build only run when someone remembers to run them locally
improvements.fix: Add a minimal GitHub Actions workflow: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm check-types, pnpm test, pnpm build

improvements.title: postcss 8.4.31 pinned by next has 2 high path-traversal advisories
improvements.summary: next@16.1.7 pins postcss@8.4.31, flagged for arbitrary file read via sourceMappingURL (2 high, 2 moderate); fixed in 8.5.23
improvements.fix: Add a pnpm override for next's postcss to >=8.5.23 (Tailwind already resolves postcss 8.5.28), run pnpm build, and re-audit

improvements.title: README preview.gif is a Git LFS pointer, so the README image is broken
improvements.summary: preview.gif is a 133-byte LFS pointer text file with no .gitattributes or LFS object in this repo - the README hero image renders broken
improvements.fix: Re-add the real GIF (fetch the LFS object from the CopilotKit source repo) as a normal file or with LFS tracked, or point the README at a hosted image

improvements.title: sharp 0.34.5 (via next) has 2 high advisories in libvips and libheif
improvements.summary: Transitive sharp@0.34.5 under next carries GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj and GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c; fixed in 0.35.4
improvements.fix: After the next bump, re-run rafa audit; if sharp is still below 0.35.4 add a pnpm override sharp >=0.35.4 and re-run pnpm build

improvements.title: Accessibility test regex-matches exact indentation in app/page.tsx
improvements.summary: page-accessibility.test.mjs extracts the Suspense fallback with a regex that hard-codes six- and four-space indentation, so a formatter run breaks the test with no behaviour change
improvements.fix: Render the fallback (react-dom/server via tsx, like SearchResults.test.tsx) and assert on the markup instead of the source text

improvements.title: The test script names each test file - a new test file silently never runs
improvements.summary: pnpm test lists four files explicitly; any new *.test.* file is skipped with no error, so coverage can erode unnoticed
improvements.fix: Switch to discovery - node --test with a glob for *.test.mjs and tsx --test for *.test.tsx - so new files are picked up automatically

improvements.title: next.config turbopack.root resolves three levels above the standalone repo
improvements.summary: turbopack.root is path.resolve(__dirname, ../../..) - the old monorepo root - so Turbopack roots itself outside this repo (for a checkout on Desktop that is the user's home dir)
improvements.fix: Set turbopack.root to __dirname (or delete the turbopack block) and run pnpm dev plus pnpm build once

improvements.title: undici 5.29.0 under @copilotkit/runtime carries 3 high advisories
improvements.summary: @copilotkit/runtime > @ai-sdk/google-vertex > @ai-sdk/provider-utils@3.0.40 pulls undici@5.29.0 - 13 advisories (3 high); fixes are in undici 7.24-8.10
improvements.fix: Check whether a newer @copilotkit/runtime (bumped together with react-core) drops the provider-utils 3.x chain; otherwise add a scoped pnpm override for undici and smoke-test a chat turn

improvements.title: Seven runtime dependencies are declared but imported nowhere
improvements.summary: @tremor/react, react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, four @radix-ui packages, date-fns, react-day-picker and class-variance-authority are template leftovers that no file imports
improvements.fix: pnpm remove the unused packages, then pnpm check-types, pnpm test and pnpm build
